gen-gf-autour-one-gf-pt-serif-caption: Bent-paperclip curves, bold and unshaded. Autour One is best at loud, smooth shapes; PT Serif Caption is best at a literary text serif with a tall x-height and mild contrast.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-suez-one: Smooth, round and bold, Autour One draws every letter with no stroke modulation at all. And Suez One, a serif with big open e and a shapes, lends the page a bookish, refined counterweight.
gen-gf-autour-one-lora: Lora brings a literary text serif with a broad, welcoming c and only slight thinning where its bowls curve. Autour One's tall, bold heading sits above it comfortably.
gen-gf-autour-one-merriweather: Cozy meets loud. Merriweather's tall middle band makes each line look stocky, with a soft thick-thin shift that keeps a long stretch of text feeling warm beside Autour One.
gen-gf-badeen-display-gf-graduate: Commanding from the first glance, Badeen Display packs lowercase that fills the line like capitals, with barely open s and c shapes. Graduate does its best work with generous white between letters and no stem-to-join contrast.
gen-gf-bakbak-one-gf-graduate: Graduate reads dignified and bookish, with generous space between letters and little gap between capitals and lowercase. Over a long passage it stays steady, which lets Bakbak One's curled, closed, outsized heading letters stand apart.
gen-gf-baloo-2-gf-epunda-slab: Expressive and full of breath, Baloo 2 lets its open counters spill into the white space. Epunda Slab is the real strength here: a dignified serif with a visibly gaping c and tall, rounded lowercase.
gen-gf-baloo-2-gf-glegoo: Glegoo gives a refined, editorial serif with big counters in a tall lowercase and curves that keep wide, unclosed mouths. Reading it runs smoothly.
gen-gf-baloo-2-gf-graduate: Graduate brings stencil-cut letters of one steady width, dignified and bookish, under Baloo 2's open, expressive headings. Baloo 2 fills the line with bowls while Graduate stays measured, spaced out and precise.
gen-gf-baloo-2-gf-kadwa: Open counters that breathe into the white space define Baloo 2, with bowls that fill the line. Kadwa follows with a larger-than-usual x-height and open-ended curves.
